title: Nifty AI Policy Document
description: Schema for the central Nifty AI governance policy document. Enforced at the tool-call boundary in OpenCode plugin and Copilot MCP server.

version.description: Schema version. Increment only on breaking changes.

policy_id.description: Stable identifier for this policy document.

effective_date.description: Date from which this policy version is active (YYYY-MM-DD).

default_effect.description: Effect applied when no rule matches. Use 'deny' for zero-trust posture.

rules.description: Ordered list of rules. First matching deny wins.

reporting.description: Global standards for AI-generated task comments and delivery reports.

suppress_routine_status_comments.description: When true, the routine 'Status set to In Progress' auto-lifecycle comment is suppressed. Default true.

require_structured_report.description: When true, all human-facing AI comments on tasks MUST use the global structured report template.

require_playwright_proof_for_visual_chan.description: MANDATORY: AI must attach Playwright screenshot proof for any change that affects UI, CSS, or front-end components.

comment_template.description: The standard template for AI-generated task comments. Sections: What was done, Completed, Evidence/Tests, How to verify, Visual proof.

engineering_quality.description: Strict delivery standards preventing hand-wavy fixes and requiring architecture-integrated, regression-tested, iterative TDD proof.

require_architectural_integration.description: Require delivery evidence explaining how the change integrates with existing architecture and avoids parallel throwaway paths.

require_tdd_red_green.description: Require RED and GREEN proof for behavioral source changes.

require_regression_proof.description: Require regression coverage evidence that locks the fixed behavior.

require_iterative_validation.description: Require evidence of an iterative reproduce/fail, implement, retest loop.

forbid_placeholder_delivery.description: Reject vague delivery claims such as 'fixed it' or 'works now'.

minimum_evidence_chars.description: Minimum length for substantive architecture, regression, and iterative proof fields.

forbidden_claim_patterns.description: Exact normalized claim strings rejected as hand-wavy placeholder evidence.

automation.description: Global automation policy for parent tasks, subtasks, docs, completion state, milestone comments, and Playwright proof capture.

task_context_gate.description: Hard mechanical gate for autonomous progress updates when active task context is missing.

enabled.description: Enable task-context gate enforcement before autonomous progress comments are emitted.

prompt_on_context_loss.description: Attempt to prompt the user for the active task card ID when context is missing.

hard_fail_if_unresolved.description: When true, fail the automation path if no task ID is recovered after prompting.

prompt.description: Prompt text shown to the user when task context is lost.

id.description: Stable identifier for this rule; used in audit logs and error messages.

action.description: Exact tool name or glob pattern. '*' matches within a segment, '**' matches any. Examples: 'nifty_delete_*', 'nifty_update_task'.

effect.description: Whether to allow or deny matching calls. Deny overrides allow.

condition.description: Optional argument-level guard. Rule only fires when condition is met.

reason.description: Human-readable explanation surfaced in the policy violation error and audit log.

_note.description: Internal annotation; not surfaced in errors or audit logs.

op.description: Comparison operator. count_gt / count_lte operate on array length.

value.description: Value to compare against. Type must match the arg and op.
